mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_stat_statements') AS ext_installed, COALESCE(current_setting('shared_preload_libraries', true), '') AS shared_preload_libraries, COALESCE(current_setting('pg_stat_statements.track', true), '') AS track, COALESCE(to_regclass('pg_stat_statements')::text, '') AS view_regclass, COALESCE(to_regclass('public.pg_stat_statements')::text, '') AS view_public, COALESCE(to_regclass('pg_catalog.pg_stat_statements')::text, '') AS view_pg_catalog
SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'pg_stat_statements'

SELECT CAST(s.queryid AS TEXT) AS query_id, s.calls, ROUND(s.total_exec_time::numeric, 2) AS total_ms, ROUND(s.mean_exec_time::numeric, 2) AS mean_ms, ROUND(s.max_exec_time::numeric, 2) AS max_ms, s.rows, s.shared_blks_hit, s.shared_blks_read, s.temp_blks_read, s.temp_blks_written,
ROUND(COALESCE(s.blk_read_time, 0)::numeric, 2)
0
AS blk_read_ms,
ROUND(COALESCE(s.blk_write_time, 0)::numeric, 2)
0
AS blk_write_ms, LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(s.query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 4000) AS query FROM pg_stat_statements s WHERE s.dbid = (SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database()) AND s.query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat_statements%' AND s.query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat_activity%'
AND s.query ILIKE '%' || #{query_like} || '%'
AND s.mean_exec_time >= CAST(#{min_mean_ms} AS NUMERIC)
AND s.calls >= CAST(#{min_calls} AS BIGINT)
ORDER BY
s.mean_exec_time s.max_exec_time s.calls s.rows s.total_exec_time
ASC DESC
LIMIT
CAST(#{limit} AS INT) 50

SELECT CAST(s.queryid AS TEXT) AS query_id, s.calls, ROUND(s.total_time::numeric, 2) AS total_ms, ROUND(s.mean_time::numeric, 2) AS mean_ms, ROUND(s.max_time::numeric, 2) AS max_ms, s.rows, s.shared_blks_hit, s.shared_blks_read, s.temp_blks_read, s.temp_blks_written,
ROUND(COALESCE(s.blk_read_time, 0)::numeric, 2)
0
AS blk_read_ms,
ROUND(COALESCE(s.blk_write_time, 0)::numeric, 2)
0
AS blk_write_ms, LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(s.query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 4000) AS query FROM pg_stat_statements s WHERE s.dbid = (SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database()) AND s.query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat_statements%' AND s.query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat_activity%'
AND s.query ILIKE '%' || #{query_like} || '%'
AND s.mean_time >= CAST(#{min_mean_ms} AS NUMERIC)
AND s.calls >= CAST(#{min_calls} AS BIGINT)
ORDER BY
s.mean_time s.max_time s.calls s.rows s.total_time
ASC DESC
LIMIT
CAST(#{limit} AS INT) 50

SELECT a.pid, a.usename, a.application_name, COALESCE(a.client_addr::text, '') AS client_addr, a.state, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - a.query_start)) * 1000 AS duration_ms, COALESCE(a.wait_event_type, '') AS wait_event_type, COALESCE(a.wait_event, '') AS wait_event, LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(a.query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 4000) AS query FROM pg_stat_activity a WHERE a.datname = current_database() AND a.state != 'idle' AND a.query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat_activity%'
AND (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - a.query_start)) * 1000) >= CAST(#{min_duration_ms} AS NUMERIC)
ORDER BY (NOW() - a.query_start) DESC LIMIT
CAST(#{limit} AS INT) 50
